def copy_template_contents(template_dir: Path, output_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Fill missing starter files without replacing existing application code."""
    if not template_dir.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Starter template directory not found: {template_dir}")
    if output_dir.is_symlink() or (output_dir.exists() and not output_dir.is_dir()):
        raise ValueError(f'Refusing to initialize a non-directory or symlink: {output_dir}')
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for source in sorted(template_dir.iterdir()):
        if source.name in {"template.yaml", "node_modules", "dist", "build", ".git", ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__", ".DS_Store", ".env", ".arc-test-db"} or source.name.startswith('.env.') or source.name.endswith(('.pyc', '.egg-info')):
            continue
        if source.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"Symlink in starter is not supported: {source}")
        destination = output_dir / source.name
        if destination.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"Refusing to initialize through symlink: {destination}")
        if source.is_dir():
            if destination.exists() and not destination.is_dir():
                raise ValueError(f"Expected directory: {destination}")
            copy_template_contents(source, destination)
        elif not destination.exists():
            shutil.copy2(source, destination)


def copy_skills_to_output(skills_dir: Path, output_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """Make the bundled ARC-Bench skills available inside Codex's workspace."""
    if not skills_dir.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Skills directory not found: {skills_dir}")
    destination = output_dir / ".codex" / "skills"
    allowed = ('arcbench-traceability', 'arcbench-checkpoint', 'arcbench-runtime-signals')
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if any(p.name not in allowed for p in destination.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError('Unexpected skills already present in output; use a clean workspace')
    for name in allowed:
        copy_template_contents(skills_dir/name, destination/name)
    return destination

def load_root_modules(requirements_dir: Path) -> list[RequirementModule]:
    requirements_path = requirements_dir / "requirements.yaml"
    if not requirements_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"requirements.yaml not found: {requirements_path}")

    payload = yaml.safe_load(requirements_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or str(payload.get("id") or "").strip() != "ROOT":
        raise ValueError("requirements.yaml must contain a ROOT mapping")

    children = payload.get("children", [])
    if not isinstance(children, list) or not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in children):
        raise ValueError("ROOT children must be a list of mappings")
    if not children:
        raise ValueError("ROOT must contain at least one child module")

    seen_ids: set[str] = set()
    seen_objects: set[int] = set()
    def check_node(node: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if id(node) in seen_objects:
            raise ValueError("Cyclic or reused requirement node")
        seen_objects.add(id(node))
        node_id = str(node.get('id') or node.get('req_id') or '').strip()
        if not node_id:
            raise ValueError("Every requirement node must have an id or req_id")
        if node_id in seen_ids:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate requirement id: {node_id}")
        seen_ids.add(node_id)
        descendants = node.get('children') or []
        if not isinstance(descendants, list) or not all(isinstance(n, dict) for n in descendants):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid children for {node_id}")
        for descendant in descendants:
            check_node(descendant)
    check_node(payload)
    compiled = compile_acceptance(payload, allow_external_dependencies=bool(
        profile_policy().get('external_dependencies_as_prerequisites', False)))
    by_id = {str(c.get("id") or c.get("req_id")).strip():c for c in children}
    children = [by_id[key] for key in compiled["module_order"]]
    root_context = {key: value for key, value in payload.items() if key != 'children'}
    root_context['module_index'] = [
        {key: child[key] for key in ('id', 'req_id', 'name', 'dependencies') if key in child}
        for child in children
    ]
    modules: list[RequirementModule] = []
    for index, subtree in enumerate(children, start=1):
        node_id = str(subtree.get("id") or subtree.get("req_id") or "").strip()
        if not node_id:
            raise ValueError(f"ROOT child {index} has no id")
        modules.append(
            RequirementModule(
                index=index,
                total=len(children),
                node_id=node_id,
                name=str(subtree.get("name") or node_id).strip(),
                subtree=subtree,
                root_context=root_context,
                acceptance=module_index(compiled, node_id),
            )
        )
    return modules

import json

def run_simple(requirements_dir, output_dir, *, policy, started=None):
    from main import (initialize_project, load_root_modules, copy_skills_to_output,
                      implement_modules, time_limit, _write_json, _redact)
    from core.evaluator_isolation import access_policy, preflight
    from core.dependencies import prepare_dependencies
    from core.workspace import prepare_workspace

    started = time.monotonic() if started is None else started
    for key in ('OPENAI_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_BASE_URL', 'MODEL'):
        if not os.environ.get(key, '').strip():
            raise ValueError(f'Missing platform environment variable: {key}')
    os.environ['HAIKNOW_PROFILE'] = policy['profile']
    limits = derive_limits(policy, (requirements_dir/'requirements.yaml').read_bytes())
    modules = load_root_modules(requirements_dir)  # Reject invalid YAML before creating output.
    model = resolve_model(policy)
    access_policy()  # Reject a retired official-read configuration before initialization.
    deadline = float('inf') if limits['total_seconds'] is None else started + limits['total_seconds']
    def available():
        if deadline == float('inf'):
            return None
        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
        if remaining <= 0:
            raise TimeoutError('Configured requirement-scaled time limit reached')
        return remaining

    agent_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    prepare_workspace(output_dir, requirements_dir/'requirements.yaml')
    initialize_project(agent_root, output_dir)
    skills = copy_skills_to_output(agent_root/'skills', output_dir)
    evidence = output_dir/'.arc/haiknow'
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    state = {'workflow':'simple', 'status':'running', 'phase':'isolation_preflight',
             'internal_acceptance_passed':False, 'gate_passed':None,
             'e2e_source':'generated_with_application', 'limits':limits,
             'model':model, 'evaluator_access':access_policy(), 'turns':[], 'validations':[]}
    _write_json(evidence/'state.json', state)
    try:
        preparation_budget = available()
        if preparation_budget is not None:
            preparation_budget -= limits['delivery_reserve_seconds']
        with time_limit(preparation_budget):
            # Preserve both real SDK checks; the starter is already visible before these or any model call.
            preflight(output_dir, evidence/'isolation/core', requirements_dir/'requirements.yaml', deadline)
            state['phase']='tooling'; _write_json(evidence/'state.json',state)
            node_modules, _ = recover('dependencies', lambda _: prepare_dependencies(evidence, deadline, project=output_dir),
                                      evidence, deadline, redact=_redact)
            state['phase']='isolation_preflight'; _write_json(evidence/'state.json',state)
            preflight(output_dir, evidence/'isolation/browser', requirements_dir/'requirements.yaml',
                      deadline, node_modules=node_modules,
                      browser_cache=evidence/'browser-cache' if (evidence/'browser-cache').is_dir() else None)
        state['phase']='implementation'; _write_json(evidence/'state.json',state)
        implement_modules(requirements_dir, output_dir, modules, skills,
            time_budget=available(), repair_attempts=limits['max_business_repair_rounds'],
            model=model, run_limits=limits,
            coding_idle_seconds=transport_limits(policy)['coding_idle_seconds'])
    except BaseException as exc:
        # A coding failure already has richer turn/validation evidence; keep it.
        current = json.loads((evidence/'state.json').read_text())
        if current.get('status') != 'failed':
            current.update(status='failed', error=_redact(f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'))
            _write_json(evidence/'state.json',current)
        raise

"""Lossless YAML index and stable code-only dependency ordering; no model I/O."""
from copy import deepcopy
import re
from core.initial_state import compile_initial_state


EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY_HANDLING = (
    'External dependency IDs are unverified prerequisites outside this input, not completed requirements. '
    'Inspect and test existing application capabilities; when absent, implement only the prerequisite '
    'behavior supported by the current descriptions and scenarios. Do not invent source requirements '
    'or passed tests.'
)


def stable_order(ids, dependencies):
    pending = list(ids)
    done = set()
    result = []
    while pending:
        ready = next((key for key in pending if dependencies[key] <= done), None)
        if ready is None:
            raise ValueError('Cyclic requirement dependencies: ' + ', '.join(pending))
        pending.remove(ready)
        done.add(ready)
        result.append(ready)
    return result


def compile_acceptance(tree, *, allow_external_dependencies=False):
    """Preserve fields/scenarios; infer only index ownership and execution edges.

    Dependencies on an ancestor express enclosing context, not completion of all
    its descendants. Other folder dependencies expand to their actual leaves.
    A cyclic module projection can have an acyclic leaf graph: preserve module
    order in that case, and expose pending cross-module dependencies explicitly.
    The original single-thread whole-module architecture is not split into jobs.
    Delta inputs may explicitly retain out-of-tree references as unverified
    prerequisites; they never become synthetic requirements or completed work.
    """
    requirements = {}
    cases = {}
    raw = {}
    leaves = []
    references = []

    def visit(node, ancestors, module):
        key = str(node.get('id') or node.get('req_id') or '').strip()
        if not key or key in raw:
            raise ValueError('Missing or duplicate requirement id: ' + key)
        raw[key] = node
        requirements[key] = {
            'ancestors': list(ancestors), 'module_id': module,
            'fields': deepcopy({k:v for k,v in node.items() if k not in {'children','scenarios'}}),
        }
        scenarios = node.get('scenarios') or []
        if not isinstance(scenarios, list) or not all(isinstance(s, dict) for s in scenarios):
            raise ValueError('Invalid scenarios: ' + key)
        for i, scenario in enumerate(scenarios, 1):
            cases[f'{key}:S{i}'] = {'source':'scenario','req_id':key,'module_id':module,
                                    'scenario':deepcopy(scenario)}
        for path in re.findall(r'!\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', str(node.get('description') or '')):
            references.append({'req_id':key,'path':path})
        children = node.get('children') or []
        if not children:
            leaves.append(key)
            if not scenarios:
                cases[f'{key}:D1'] = {'source':'description','req_id':key,'module_id':module,
                                      'description':deepcopy(node.get('description',''))}
        for child in children:
            child_id = str(child.get('id') or child.get('req_id') or '').strip()
            visit(child, [*ancestors,key], child_id if key == 'ROOT' else module)

    visit(tree, [], None)
    descendants = {key:{leaf for leaf in leaves if leaf == key or key in requirements[leaf]['ancestors']}
                   for key in raw}
    dependencies = {}
    external_dependencies = {}
    for leaf in leaves:
        parents = requirements[leaf]['ancestors']
        needed = set()
        external = set()
        for owner in [*parents,leaf]:
            refs = raw[owner].get('dependencies') or []
            if not isinstance(refs, list) or not all(isinstance(r, str) for r in refs):
                raise ValueError('Invalid dependencies: ' + owner)
            for ref in refs:
                if ref not in raw:
                    if not allow_external_dependencies:
                        raise ValueError('Unknown dependency: ' + ref)
                    external.add(ref)
                    continue
                if ref in parents:
                    continue
                needed.update(descendants[ref])
        dependencies[leaf] = needed
        if external:
            external_dependencies[leaf] = sorted(external)
    leaf_order = stable_order(leaves, dependencies)
    module_ids = [str(c.get('id') or c.get('req_id')).strip() for c in tree['children']]
    module_deps = {key:set() for key in module_ids}
    for leaf, refs in dependencies.items():
        owner = requirements[leaf]['module_id']
        module_deps[owner].update(requirements[r]['module_id'] for r in refs
                                  if requirements[r]['module_id'] != owner)
    warnings = []
    if external_dependencies:
        warnings.append(EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY_HANDLING + ' Referenced IDs: ' + ', '.join(
            sorted({ref for refs in external_dependencies.values() for ref in refs})))
    try:
        module_order = stable_order(module_ids, module_deps)
    except ValueError:
        module_order = module_ids
        warnings.append('Interleaved module dependencies: implement shared prerequisites as needed; '
                        'revisit pending cross-module journeys during final integration.')
    consumers = {key:[] for key in leaves}
    for leaf, refs in dependencies.items():
        for ref in refs:
            consumers[ref].append(leaf)
    initial_state = compile_initial_state(requirements, cases)
    from core.runtime_contracts import compile_runtime_contracts
    runtime_contracts = compile_runtime_contracts({'requirements':requirements,'cases':cases})
    compiled = {'runtime_contracts':runtime_contracts, 'initial_state': initial_state, 'initial_records': [f for f in initial_state['facts'] if f['predicate']=='exists'], 'schema_version':1,'requirements':requirements,'cases':cases,'references':references,
            'leaf_order':leaf_order,'dependencies':{k:sorted(v) for k,v in dependencies.items()},
            'module_order':module_order,'module_dependencies':{k:sorted(v) for k,v in module_deps.items()},
            'shared_prerequisites':[{'req_id':k,'consumers':consumers[k]} for k in leaves if len(consumers[k])>1],
            'warnings':warnings}
    if external_dependencies:
        compiled['external_dependencies'] = external_dependencies
    return compiled


def module_index(compiled, module_id):
    relevant = {key for key, value in compiled['requirements'].items() if value['module_id'] == module_id}
    external = {

"""Bind necessary image text to original requirements, never to a whole OCR dump."""
from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
from core.profile import profile_enabled

POLICY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'competition/reference-images.json'


def images_enabled():
    if not profile_enabled():
        return False
    default = json.loads(POLICY.read_text())['enabled']
    switch = os.environ.get('HAIKNOW_PARSE_REFERENCE_IMAGES', str(default)).strip().lower()
    if switch not in {'true', 'false'}:
        raise ValueError('HAIKNOW_PARSE_REFERENCE_IMAGES must be true or false')
    return switch == 'true'


def reference_contexts(requirements_dir, acceptance):
    """Only explicit functional delegations qualify. Unknown wording stays unresolved.

    Matching patterns are configurable because future organizer wording is unknown.
    A mention of an image, style or layout alone never enables extraction.
    """
    if not profile_enabled():
        return {}
    root = Path(requirements_dir).resolve()
    policy = json.loads(POLICY.read_text())
    result = {}
    nodes = acceptance['requirements']
    for req_id, node in nodes.items():
        scenarios = [v['scenario'] for v in acceptance['cases'].values()
                     if v['req_id'] == req_id and v['source'] == 'scenario']
        description = str(node['fields'].get('description', ''))
        texts = [description]
        for scenario in scenarios:
            texts.extend(str(step.get('content', '')) for step in scenario.get('steps', []))
        requests = []
        for item in policy['delegation_patterns']:
            for text in texts:
                requests.extend({'kind': item['kind'], 'source_quote': match.group(0)}
                                for match in re.finditer(item['pattern'], text, flags=re.I))
        if not requests:
            continue
        owner_ids = {req_id, *node['ancestors']}
        for reference in acceptance['references']:
            if reference['req_id'] not in owner_ids:
                continue
            url = urlsplit(reference['path'])
            if url.scheme or url.netloc:
                continue
            candidate = root / unquote(url.path)
            path = candidate.resolve()
            if not path.is_relative_to(root) or candidate.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                continue
            if path.stat().st_size > 20 * 1024 * 1024:
                continue
            digest = sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            result.setdefault(digest, []).append({
                'req_id': req_id, 'image_path': str(path.relative_to(root)),
                'description': description, 'scenarios': deepcopy(scenarios),
                'ancestors': [{'req_id': key, 'fields': deepcopy(nodes[key]['fields'])}
                              for key in node['ancestors']],
                'requests': requests,
            })
    return result


def parse_visual_facts(note, contexts):
    payload = json.loads(note)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or not isinstance(payload.get('facts'), list):
        raise ValueError('Expected scoped visual facts JSON')
    if type(payload.get('required_by_text')) is not bool:
        raise ValueError('Missing required_by_text decision')
    if not payload['required_by_text'] and payload['facts']:
        raise ValueError('Style-only references cannot add facts')
    if len(payload['facts']) > 16:
        raise ValueError('Too many visual facts; not a full-image OCR channel')
    facts = []
    for fact in payload['facts']:
        if not isinstance(fact, dict) or not isinstance(fact.get('text'), str) or not 0 < len(fact['text']) <= 1000:
            raise ValueError('Invalid exact visual text')
        owners = [context for context in contexts if context['req_id'] == fact.get('req_id')
                  and any(request['kind'] == fact.get('kind') and
                          request['source_quote'] == fact.get('source_quote') for request in context['requests'])]
        if not owners:
            raise ValueError('Visual fact has no matching original functional delegation')
        facts.append({key: fact[key] for key in ('req_id', 'kind', 'source_quote', 'text')} |
                     {'image_path': owners[0]['image_path'], 'source': 'scoped_visual_extraction'})
    return facts
